title: 纳尔·小石头塔
description: 橙色绒毛纳尔蹲在草地上堆圆石头，骨质回旋镖安静放在布垫旁。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Gnar is a tiny orange-furred prehistoric yordle with oversized pointed ears, bright blue eyes, a broad curious face, little fangs kept unobtrusive, and a long fluffy tail. Preserve his primitive small garment wrap and bone-like adornments without turning him into a human child. His recognizable boomerang lies flat beside a cloth mat, inactive and never being thrown.
art_direction.scene: He crouches in a sunny clearing and balances one smooth pebble on a short tower of three rounded stones. His ears tilt in different directions with playful concentration, and his free hand steadies the lowest rock. A simple fern and distant rounded hill complete the setting, while the full tail curls inside the square.
art_direction.palette: tangerine orange, sky blue, warm stone gray, fern green
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
